author: Giorgio Mendoza
description: The ESP32 Bus Pirate project has been renamed ESP32 Bit Pirate as part of its continued development as an ESP32-S3-based multi-protocol firmware platform. The open-source project, developed by Geo-tp, turns supported ESP32-S3 boards into debugging and experimentation tools for wired protocols, radio interfaces, scripting, and browser-based interaction. title: ESP32 Bit Pirate update adds WiFi Hotspot mode, Pirate Assistant, and Web Flasher
